warnings.title: Warnings
warnings.failed_plugins: Moonraker has failed plugins: {{list}}. Check moonraker.log, fix the configuration, and restart Moonraker.
warnings.missing: Klipper is missing sections Moonraker needs: {{list}}

host.title: Host
host.no_details: Moonraker didn’t report the host’s details.

database.title: Moonraker database
database.restore_body: Moonraker’s database, including Fluidd’s and Valve Oil UI’s settings, history, and file details, goes back to {{name}}. Moonraker restarts to load it.

usage.title: System utilization
usage.system_load_hint: Load average: how many processes want the CPU, out of its cores
usage.klipper_load_hint: Klipper’s CPU use as a share of one core
usage.klipper_load_hint_thread: Klipper’s CPU use, and its main thread, the one that has to keep up with endstops and heaters, as a share of one core
usage.timers_hint: Klipper walks every timer on each pass of its main loop, so a count that keeps climbing slows it down

services.title: Services
services.locked: Klipper and Moonraker can’t be restarted while Valve Oil updates the printer.

about.moonraker: Klipper’s API server, which Fluidd and Valve Oil UI talk to
about.klipper_mcu: Klipper’s host MCU, for pins on the printer’s computer
about.remote_screen: Streams the touchscreen to the Printer screen tab

ask.klipper_stop: The printer stops responding until Klipper is started again.
ask.klipper_restart: Klipper reloads its configuration and reconnects to the printer’s boards.
ask.moonraker: Fluidd and Valve Oil UI lose the printer for a few seconds, then reconnect.
ask.qidi_stop: The touchscreen stays off until you start it again or the printer reboots.
ask.qidi_restart: The touchscreen goes blank for a few seconds while its app restarts.

klipper.fw_body: Klipper reloads its configuration and restarts the printer’s boards.
klipper.fw_hint: Reloads Klipper’s configuration and restarts the MCUs

host.about: The printer’s computer, which runs Klipper, Moonraker, and the touchscreen.
host.reboot_body: The printer’s computer restarts, and Valve Oil UI reconnects when it’s back, in about a minute.
host.shutdown_body: The printer’s computer shuts down. Turn the printer off and on again to start it.

logs.title: Logs
logs.rollover_hint: Start new klippy.log and moonraker.log files
logs.report_hint: Reporting a problem? Use Report a problem on the Updates screen. It downloads a support bundle with these logs to attach to the report.
logs.name: Name
logs.rollover_about: Starts a new log file and keeps the old one beside it, dated.
logs.rollover_about_printing: Starts a new log file and keeps the old one beside it, dated. Klipper’s log can’t be rolled over during a print.

diagnostics.about: Chart any value Klipper reports, live, over the last 20 minutes. Each chart’s lines are collectors: expressions such as {{example}}. The charts are shared with Fluidd’s Diagnostics page.
diagnostics.paused: Charts pause until Klipper is ready.
diagnostics.none: No charts. Add one to chart a value.
diagnostics.no_lines: This chart has no lines. Edit it to add some.

editor.remove_body: {{title}} is removed from Valve Oil UI and Fluidd.
editor.title: Title
editor.height_hint: The whole card’s chart area; with both axes on, each gets half.
editor.separate_axes: Valve Oil UI draws each y-axis as its own chart, one above the other. Fluidd draws them together.
editor.name: Name

explorer.pick_hint: Pick a field to add its path to the collector.
explorer.copy_hint: Click a field to copy its path, for a chart’s collector.

screen.control_body: Clicks, taps, and drags on the image will press the printer’s touchscreen, including during a print. Turn control on?
screen.about: The touchscreen as it is now. Turn on control to press it from here. To restart the touchscreen if it freezes, restart {{service}} under Services.
screen.paused: Paused while this tab is hidden.
